baseline.scope: Actual custom-domain main viewer captured before this correction, not source fixtures

findingsBefore: Regular nearly straight radial arms and narrow tips; arm length relative to the mantle was weak.
Separate mantle/head lofts and a dorsal bridge left visible joins; eye cues appeared manufactured.
A short funnel lumen met approximate body tissue rather than an open path into a selected cavity.
Skin was dominated by coarse numerical mottling; fine raised cellular appearance was weak and UVs stretched.
The reach was mostly a lift/bend; support/recovery geometry lacked a source-linked travelling bend/extension comparison.
changes: Selected asymmetric longer arm paths with closed rounded tip caps and seam-normal continuity replace the straighter short spread.
A closed connected mantle-wall/head/crown field joins eye bulges and basal tissue. Selected local membrane/arm transitions remain approximate.
The external funnel has a cleared route into an illustrative mantle-wall cavity. A rejected draft hid the funnel behind basal arms; placement and clearances were revised.

Original512² cellular pigment/height fields and bind-space three-planar mapping add finer surface detail that stays attached during deformation. No source photographs or paper figures became texture pixels.
Finite authored support/recovery holds selected distal target regions while the body advances; unevenly timed recovery events avoid a generic periodic pinwheel.
Exploratory reaching combines a distally progressing bend and selected proximal extension/radius adjustment, then returns. Food handling and physiological control remain absent.
Baked reproducible core geometry avoids synchronous isosurface construction in the main viewer. Corrupt/missing payload handling retains a numerical-source fallback.
findingsAfter: The joined lower torso, longer asymmetric arms and smaller integrated eye cues improve the external study, but selected spread/proportions and iris/cornea remain stylized.
Enlarged ventral views show exposed proximal sucker rows after rejecting a core-occlusion draft; internal sucker tissues, count/spacing and full adhesion remain unmeasured.
The selected funnel route is open instead of showing the old tissue plug; the tubular lip/cavity still do not reconstruct the complete mantle organs or flow.
Fine cellular colour/relief stays attached through local bends, but papilla distribution and optical diversity remain numerical artwork.
Intermediate reach and support views retain the same model and finite endpoints; full contact/force/traction and measured motor timing remain absent.
limitations: This remains an unmeasured, partly stylized external adult study. The asymmetric spread is one authored inspection posture, not a fitted resting individual. Selected arm lengths, distal curling/taper, web thickness and unions, head/eye position, iris/cornea, mantle wall/cavity, papilla distribution and pigment/optical diversity are approximate. The retained38sucker pairs per arm, radial grooves and short orifices do not reconstruct complete acetabula or fine circumferential/microscopic tissue. A cleared illustrative funnel route does not establish internal anatomical fidelity, valves, respiratory organs, pressure or water flow. Proximal extension/radius adjustment and a travelling bend are authored mechanisms, not measured strains or a muscular-hydrostat solver. Selected distal support regions compensate for body translation; suction, mucus/traction, force equilibrium, whole-body and between-sample contact/collision freedom, complete crawling, prey handling and jet escape remain unavailable. Coded finite sequences are not an inferred motor-controller or measured cadence. Skin fields are original numerical artwork, not photograph/SEM pixels, camouflage physiology or calibrated natural optics. Compatibility/export uses restrained coarse numerical grain instead of the main cellular shader detail, with reduced fidelity. No90-percent score, independent specialist review or biological validation is claimed.

anatomy.name: Eight arms
anatomy.description: Eight retained continuous arm surfaces have selected asymmetric curvature, thick proximal sections, rounded closed ends and moving basal web margins. The head/mantle/crown exterior is joined as a selected field; local arm/web unions remain approximate. A travelling bend and authored proximal elongation illustrate reaching. Mouth/beak, muscles, nerves and physiological control are not reconstructed.

anatomy.name: Suckers
anatomy.description: Selected paired rows with folded external rims, selected radial relief, an uncapped central orifice and short throat. Internal acetabulum/protuberance, microscopic denticles/hairs, pressure, sealing and attachment mechanics are not modelled. Inspection lighting is disclosed separately from natural optical appearance.

No measured recruitment pattern, suction, traction, force balance, full self-collision or complete locomotor simulation.

softwareScope: Mesh topology, open route, retained geometry/reset, selected support, sampled distal envelopes and numerical-source reproducibility are software consistency checks. They do not validate living anatomy, physiology or full contact mechanics.
draftHistory: Initial preview exposed overly uniform curling, coarse/faceted core relief and a funnel hidden by basal tissues. Closed-core checks found60open boundary edges at a clipped construction bound; the domain was enlarged, retaining the closed/connected gate. An authored recovery path produced a sampled distal arm6/7 overlap; selected curvature was changed and the complete sampled finite interval rechecked. A new cap test initially used an incorrect absolute-height assumption for proximal rings; it was corrected to test membership of the actual proximal boundary while retaining exactly32boundary edges. A metadata check had a case-sensitive wording mismatch, corrected without changing biological status. A33frame compiled candidate was withheld after its inspected underside detail exposed proximal sucker faces hidden by core stubs; flattened basal tissue and a new selected lip-exposure gate corrected that regression before full recapture. Six software-fallback drafts exposed UV-stretched cellular dots and were rejected; UV grain replaced those fields in the standard material while the custom main shader stayed unchanged. All33 ordered main recaptures were byte-identical to the inspected final PNGs, and six new fallback Observe axis/detail captures were inspected. The corrected geometry passed256full local checks before this final material-only change;16affected checks passed after it. Full CI on the published source is checked separately during release verification. All earlier draft captures are private and excluded from final counts.
